column1: # ScreenSwitch 文字表（docs/settings-ui-design.md 第 8 节）：编号<TAB>中文<TAB>英文。{0} {1} 为占位，\n 表示换行。两端共用。

column2: 编码要在 1 到 255 之间。
column3: A code must be between 1 and 255.

column2: 这台电脑所接的口不能改；换了接口请重新检测主屏。
column3: The port of this computer cannot be changed here; detect the main screen again if you moved the cable.

column2: 只能有一个口接对方电脑。
column3: Only one port can be the other computer.

column2: 请给 {0} 上的设备起个名字。
配置文件读不了（{0}），先修好或删掉 config.json 再改设置。
column3: config.json cannot be read ({0}); fix or delete it before changing settings.

column3: A device code must be between 1 and 255.
Please give the device a name.

column2: {0} 是这台电脑所接的口，不能给设备用。
column3: {0} is the port of this computer and cannot be a device.

column2: {0} 是 {1} 所接的口，不能给设备用。
column3: {0} is the port of {1} and cannot be a device.

column2: 没有编码为 {0} 的设备。
column3: There is no device with code {0}.

column2: 系统只能是 windows 或 mac。
column3: The system must be windows or mac.

column2: 地址不能为空，只能用字母、数字、点、连字符和下划线。
column3: The address cannot be empty and may only contain letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

column2: 用户名不能为空，也不能有空格、引号、@ 等符号。
column3: The user name cannot be empty or contain spaces, quotes, @ and similar characters.

column2: 快捷键写法不对：{0}（例如 Ctrl+Alt+1，要带 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 或 Win）
column3: Invalid shortcut: {0} (for example Ctrl+Alt+1; it needs Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win)

column2: 切给对方 / 拿回主屏
column3: Switch to the other computer / take back

column2: 开机自动运行没能设置：{0}
column3: Could not change start at login: {0}

column2: 程序旁边没有 setup-client.ps1，请在仓库目录里手动运行：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File setup-client.ps1 -PeerUser {0} -PeerHost {1}
column3: setup-client.ps1 is not next to the program; run it by hand in the repository folder: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File setup-client.ps1 -PeerUser {0} -PeerHost {1}

column2: 没有显示器应答 DDC/CI。可能的原因：显示器菜单里没有打开 DDC/CI；连接线、扩展坞或转接头不传 DDC；主屏此刻没在显示这台电脑（把主屏切到这台电脑后再试）。
column3: No display answers DDC/CI. Possible causes: DDC/CI is off in the monitor's own menu; the cable, dock or adapter does not pass DDC; the main screen is not showing this computer right now (switch it to this computer and try again).

column2: 这台电脑接了 {0} 块屏，三块及以上的屏不支持：只留主屏，或主屏加另一块屏。
column3: This computer has {0} screens; three or more are not supported. Keep only the main screen, or the main screen plus one more.

column2: 有几块显示器应答 DDC/CI，请指定哪一块是主屏。
column3: Several displays answer DDC/CI; choose which one is the main screen.

column2: 没有找到型号为 {0} 且应答 DDC/CI 的显示器。
column3: No display with model {0} answers DDC/CI.
The other computer is not set up yet.

column2: 连不上 {0}：确认它开着、在同一个局域网、已经授权了这台电脑的公钥。
column3: Cannot reach {0}: check it is on, on the same network, and has authorised this computer's key.

column2: 这不像一把 SSH 公钥（应以 ssh-ed25519 或 ssh-rsa 开头）。
column3: This does not look like an SSH public key (it should start with ssh-ed25519 or ssh-rsa).

column2: 授权需要管理员权限。请在管理员 PowerShell 里执行：{0}
column3: Authorising needs administrator rights. Run this in an administrator PowerShell: {0}

column2: 在系统确认框里取消了，没有授权。
column3: Cancelled in the system prompt; nothing was authorised.

column2: 程序旁边没有 setup-sshd.ps1，请重新运行 install.cmd。
column3: setup-sshd.ps1 is not next to the program; run install.cmd again.

column2: 授权没有成功（{0}），详情见 setup-sshd.log。
还没有设置：请运行设置向导。
column3: Not set up yet: run the setup wizard.
The tray app is not running.

column2: 不知道 {0} 接在哪个输入口：在设置的“输入口”里标出来，或点“测试连接”。
column3: It is not known which input {0} uses: mark it under Inputs in Settings, or click Test connection.

column2: {0} 接在编码 {1} 的输入口。
连上了 {0}，但它还不知道自己接在哪个输入口。
column3: Reached {0}, but it does not know its own input yet.
The main screen is not set up yet

column2: 正在读取主屏的输入口（要几秒）…
column3: Reading the main screen's inputs (takes a few seconds)…

column2: 读不出主屏有哪些输入口：下面只列已登记的，可以手动添加。
column3: Could not read the main screen's inputs; only the registered ones are listed, and you can add more.

column2: 输入口的编码（1–255，常见：15 DP 1、16 DP 2、17 HDMI 1、18 HDMI 2）：
column3: Input code (1–255; common: 15 DP 1, 16 DP 2, 17 HDMI 1, 18 HDMI 2):

column2: 几块显示器都能控制，哪一块是主屏？
column3: Several displays can be controlled. Which one is the main screen?

column2: 这台电脑的公钥：把它粘贴到对方电脑设置窗口的“对方公钥”里，点“授权”。
column3: This computer's public key: paste it into "Other computer's key" in the other computer's Settings and click Authorise.

column2: （对方是 Mac 时，还要在 Mac 的“系统设置 → 通用 → 共享”里打开“远程登录”。）
column3: (If the other computer is a Mac, also turn on Remote Login in System Settings → General → Sharing on the Mac.)

column2: 已连上 {0}，它还不知道自己接在哪个口。
column3: Connected to {0}; it does not know its own input yet.

column2: 注意：输入口里标的对方电脑是 {0}，而它报告的是 {1}。
column3: Note: Inputs marks {0} as the other computer, but it reports {1}.

column2: 不连对方电脑也能用，只是主屏不在这台电脑上时，要用显示器按钮切回来。
column3: It works without the other computer too; you will then use the monitor's button to switch back when the main screen is elsewhere.
After taking back the main screen:

column2: 在系统设置里拖动两块屏的位置后，自动记住，下次拿回时按这个位置恢复。
column3: After you drag the screens around in Windows Settings, the new arrangement is remembered and restored the next time you take back the main screen.

column2: 立刻记下现在两块屏的位置，作用同上。
column3: Records the current arrangement right away; same effect as above.

column2: 默认没有快捷键。点输入框后按下组合键即可设置（要带 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 或 Win）。
column3: There are no shortcuts by default. Click a box and press a key combination (with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win).

column2: 没能注册：可能被别的程序占用。
column3: Could not register; another program may be using it.

column2: 先直接切换（显示器在其他输入口也接受指令时更快）
column3: Try switching directly first (faster on monitors that accept commands on any input)

column2: 拿回主屏后执行的命令：
column3: Command to run after taking back the main screen:

column2: 打开配置文件所在的文件夹
column3: Open the folder with the configuration

column2: 快捷键 {0} 没能注册（可能被别的程序占用）
column3: Shortcut {0} could not be registered (another program may be using it)

column2: 配置文件读不了，已用默认值
column3: The configuration could not be read; defaults are in use
Please wait for the current switch to finish

column2: 配置文件有误，改动没有生效
column3: config.json has an error; the change was not applied

column2: 请先在双屏状态下保存布局
column3: Save the layout while both screens are on

column2: 右键托盘图标，打开“设置…”，在“屏幕”页点“现在记住当前排列”。
column3: Right-click the tray icon, open Settings…, and click "Remember the current arrangement now" on the Screens page.
